patterns: Games and tech crossovers still top the board: DiscussingFilm's Rockstar quote on why GTA 6 took so long did 3,683,187 views, and the Xbox 25th-anniversary note did 365,503.

Awards-night arrival posts flood the feed and pay off: FilmUpdates posted 34 originals, most from the Governors Awards. Chalamet's arrival did 776,633, Florence Pugh 536,468, and Glenn Close's honorary Oscar 433,575 with 28,814 likes, the best like rate of the day.
A plain chart claim lands big: FilmUpdates' 'THE BODY is the #1 TV show on Netflix worldwide' did 1,353,892 views and 72,062 likes.

Filmmaker quotes keep traveling: Villeneuve on DUNE: PART 3's mixed formats did 871,625, Damon saying Affleck keeps praising Pattinson in THE ODYSSEY 746,734, and the HEXED 'last traditional Disney art style' line 643,177.

Small accounts win with one-line, no-context captions and rating prompts: CinemaTweets1's 'A Paul Thomas Anderson Masterpiece' did 42,555 and the DiCaprio 'deserved an Oscar nomination' line 38,800. ATRightMovies' classic-scene and behind-the-scenes posts did 20-33K, and its 'rate X out of 10' prompts 16-22K.
RottenTomatoes does best with franchise sneak peeks: the Harry Potter series peek did 61,374.
narrative_synthesis: Governors Awards Sunday: DiscussingFilm's GTA 6 quote led at 3,683,187 views, FilmUpdates' THE BODY Netflix #1 post did 1,353,892, and a run of Governors Awards arrivals (Chalamet 776,633, Pugh 536,468, Glenn Close's honorary Oscar 433,575) filled the top. 92 originals scanned, 90 at 5K+, 82 at 10K+.
